prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE wide 3:2 landscape scenic plate, 1536x1024, for Wonder Together’s paper-boat story. Quiet luxury picture-book illustration with finely drawn ink, tactile warm ivory paper, translucent muted watercolor, cinematic natural morning light, restrained blue-gray water and rare copper/gold. Editorial Newsreader and Inter energy without any typography. Setting: a calm warm workshop with a blue-gray enamel tub of clear water on a walnut table. The recurring boat is an open ivory paper hull with folded walls, a broad flat bottom, folded pointed ends and no sail. Copper pennies are plain unlabeled discs. Big and Little Wonderer are NONHUMAN minimal warm-gray and cream pebble/capsule guides, dot eyes, a subtle nose dash, very short mitten arms and tiny feet. Big is 1.6 times Little’s height, calmly beside or behind Little. No humans, bears, plush toys, costumes or detailed paws. No text, letters, titles, numbers, labels, arrows, diagrams, panels, borders, giant hands, tip-hand, logos or watermarks. Apparatus and tangible paper dominate. A wide establishing scene at table height: Little and Big stand beside a fresh flat ivory paper sheet in the foreground. A few copper pennies wait beside it. Beyond, the oval blue-gray enamel tub catches a window reflection in calm water. No folded boat yet. Little leans close to the sheet as if imagining its possibilities. A short blank folded instruction leaflet lies nearby without writing. Spacious quiet anticipation, warm window light from the left.
